title: perf: fix overlap scheduling and all-reduce fusion for NVIDIA Confidential Computing(CC) on Blackwell

## Motivation

Two fixes so SGLang runs efficiently under **NVIDIA Confidential Computing (CC)**, where the GPU operates behind a bounce buffer:

title: Optimize batched_moe_align_block_size_kernel with cooperative writes
body_opening:
Summary:
Upstream the optimization from D93429906 (avocado_v1) to trunk.

The original implementation had each thread serially write all tokens for its batch, creating a bottleneck when individual batches have many tokens. This replaces the serial per-thread writes with cooperative all-thread writes using shared memory: per-batch results (cumsum, token counts) are stored to shared memory after the prefix sum, then all 1024 threads participate in strided loops to write sorted_ids and block_ids for every batch. This distributes the memory write work evenly across the entire thread block.

No API changes — the host function and kernel signature are unchanged.
